# pvecli node info

Show detailed information about a node.

```text
pvecli node info [NODE] [OPTIONS]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `NODE` | Node name. |

## Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `-a`, `--all` | Show all nodes. |
